title: Quick decisions land after a stated 8-second undo window, not on the click
deviations_from_card: (1) Only REJECTS go through the window (ledger reject + candidate modal Reject). Accepts still call act() on the click. Why: the critic's revision says every window write must go through commitDecision and never through act(), but an accept's handoff (queued-for-Schedule banner, background interview_prep, an offer's secure link + sentOffers) is applied by applyHandoffs/state inside useDecisionsQueue.ts, which is outside this card's write set. Deferring accepts through commitDecision would silently drop those handoffs (a regression of slot A). A forward move is also not the emailed, sealed, terminal act the card's premise is about (pipeline-entry-action.ts only dispatches the rejection email + ATS candidate.rejected on action==='reject'). The reducer supports both actions (case 4 arms an accept). (2) A tab switch does not flush early: the module-scoped timer keeps running and commits on time (the card's own design: 'the payload outlives the tab'); pagehide flushes synchronously. No beforeunload prompt (the keepalive flush makes it unnecessary). (3) Added acceptance 9 per the critic revise (commitDecision keepalive POST with expectedStage, source scan of the literal, store never calls act() or fetch, pagehide handler synchronous). (4) Reducer state carries inflight + landed overlays so a flushed or landed reject stays hidden until the queue re-read (triggered by notifyDataChanged after each commit) no longer lists it; pruned in the section against visibleAiReviews.
